mainEntity.name: Is bonus progress retained after logging out of your account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accrued bonuses and fulfilled conditions are usually linked to your account, rather than to an open browser session. After logging back in, you can check your current balance and the status of your rewards, if this feature is supported by the platform.

mainEntity.name: How can I find out which games have the highest RTP?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Return to Player (RTP) rate is usually indicated in the information menu for a specific slot machine. Before starting to play, you can open the rules to check the theoretical return percentage, volatility and paytable. RTP is a long-term mathematical indicator, not a prediction of the outcome of a single session.

mainEntity.name: Can I change my payment method after topping up my account?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice of a different withdrawal method depends on the casino’s payment policy. Additional verification may be required to confirm the new details. Withdrawals are usually made to payment methods belonging to the gaming account holder.

mainEntity.name: What happens to unused free spins once the promotion has ended?

acceptedAnswer.text: Free spins usually have a specific expiry date. If 430 FS are spread across several stages of the welcome package, each stage may have its own activation period. Unused spins are handled in accordance with the bonus rules.

mainEntity.name: What determines a player’s position in the tournament leaderboard?

acceptedAnswer.text: A player’s position on the leaderboard may be determined by the number of points scored, winning multipliers or results on specially selected slots. The specific scoring system depends on the rules of the tournament with a prize pool of £600,000
